`vosk-test.wav` was copied from [`alphacep/vosk-api`](https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api/tree/master/python/example) and is retained here as a small committed speech fixture for local/manual regression checks.

Source file:
- `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alphacep/vosk-api/master/python/example/test.wav`

Upstream license:
- Apache-2.0

The CI assertion uses a deterministic macOS-generated TTS clip instead of this file, so the automated test transcript is not tied to a third-party sample transcript.
